designation: The 61-80 evaluation is prospectively designated a PILOT because the preregistered audit identified only three informative v3-treatment cases. It may provide mechanism evidence but is NOT powered to estimate the v3 treatment effect. Goal 80 remains part of system-level scoring but is EXCLUDED from the multi-member mechanism analysis because its prerequisite is absent by construction under isolated per-goal evaluation.

GOAL80.label: HARD_DEPENDENCY_UNINFORMATIVE_FOR_A
GOAL80.reason: snapshot() calls library.toJSON() and restore() calls Library.fromJSON, both of which are goal 71 and therefore absent from the frozen post-60 world. Under the preregistered per-goal-isolation design neither arm can achieve it.
GOAL80.discovered: from goal text during the pre-inference audit, before any model output existed

analysis_restrictions.no_significance_for_A_or_B: At n=1 and n=2 a p-value would be meaningless and must not be computed or advertised.
questions_are_mechanistic_only: Did goal 71 actually enter v3's sequential multi-member path?
Did v2 fail goal 71 in the way its frozen limitation predicts (only members[0] inserted)?
Did v3 complete BOTH members, with each span re-baselined on the previous success?
Did goals 64 and 74 actually enter safe behavioural replacement?
Did the old-behaviour regression stay green across the replacement?
Did the requested new delta pass?
Did rollback work byte-for-byte where either half failed?
Did the non-treatment goals remain approximately unchanged between arms?
analysis_restrictions.interpretation_if_all_three_succeed: prospective mechanism evidence, NOT a population effect estimate
analysis_restrictions.interpretation_if_all_three_fail: the development fixtures did not transfer to real model inference - equally valuable
analysis_restrictions.pooling_prohibition: After this run, 61-80 become PILOT/development data. They must NOT later be pooled into a confirmatory v3 result as though they had not been inspected.

next_step_if_underpowered: Audit 81-100 after building and proving a canonical post-80 world. If that range also lacks enough v3-treatment goals, do NOT force the original 100-goal sequence to answer a question it was not designed to answer - build a fresh benchmark sampling the architecture's claimed lanes (multi-member transactions, single-span behavioural evolution, ordinary localized additions, unsupported multi-site changes), with task generation and evaluation independent of model output.
